statement_original: TCDD opens heterochromatin-marked (H3K9me3) domains specifically in vascular smooth muscle cells.
The SMC chromatin opening exceeds a GC-content- and TSS-matched null, while the other three lineages do not.
rule: SMC p<0.05 且其余三条 p>0.05

statement_original: SMC-specific Ahr deletion reverses only part of the opening, i.e. the opening is AhR-dependent but not AhR-exclusive.
value: 对照 0.01542 / WT 0.01615 / AhrKO 0.01581；回落 47%（AhrKO 仍保留 WT 增益的 53%）
rule: AhrKO 高于对照且低于 WT

statement_original: SMC open bins are enriched for the Ahr::Arnt motif, consistent with direct AhR recruitment.
The motifs enriched in endothelial open bins identify the upstream factor that opens them (originally named as KLF2 / HIF1A / EPAS1).
value: n=30，FDR<0.05 的 motif 0 个；Ahr::Arnt p=0.272
rule: 至少 1 个 motif 过 FDR<0.05

statement_original: Endothelial accessibility changes are not reversed by SMC-specific Ahr deletion, i.e. the endothelial arm is non-cell-autonomous.
value: d=0.544；对照 -0.0248 / WT -0.02128 / AhrKO -0.02148；KO 与 WT 相差 6% 的 WT−Ctrl 落差
rule: AhrKO 与 WT 接近（<25% 落差）且两者都远离对照

statement_original: After depth-matched downsampling, domain-level effects keep both their direction and their significance.
value: 方向 24/24；判定 holds 7/12，其余 direction only

statement_original: Per-cell endpoints are stable in direction under depth matching.
value: 67/72 个组合三次稀释全部同号；非全同号的 5 个：Endothelial/frac_het/AhrKO(2/3), Immune/prom_het_rel/AhrKO(1/3), Immune/prom_het_rel/WT(0/3), Mesenchymal/frac_het/AhrKO(0/3), Macrophage/LAM/WT(2/3)
rule: 主终点（EC het_derepression / SMC frac_het / Mac LAM / Fib matrix）不出现 0/3

statement_original: Within-animal 80% cell resampling keeps all primary endpoints in the same direction (no single animal drives the effect).
value: 最低同号比例 1.000（4 个终点）

statement_original: After Kitagawa decomposition of the raw difference into composition, within-state and interaction terms, most endpoints are cell-intrinsic.
Cell-composition shifts cannot be declared significant at this sample size.
value: 精确置换最小 p = 0.143（7 个成分）

statement_original: At the animal level only the myeloid LAM state and the fibroblast matrix-ligand program remain significant; the endothelial and SMC endpoints do not.
All four mouse-derived programs (LAM, ECpanel, Matrix, ModSMC) map specifically onto their canonical human cell types.
value: LAM：Mac 0.4；ECpanel：EC 0.29；ModSMC：SMC 0.21 vs Fib 0.28；Matrix：SMC 0.16 vs Fib 0.69
rule: 每个程序在其目标细胞类型最高

statement_original: Environment-remodelled chromatin targets are genetically independent of common CAD risk loci.
value: OR=0.529, Fisher p=9.5e-29, 面板 1993 vs 背景 4157

statement_original: SMC open bins do not show ligand-specific (TCDD > DMSO) AHR occupancy.
The branch point holds within donors: myeloid–matrix coupling exceeds endothelial–matrix coupling in every donor.
value: 8/8 供体为正，中位差 0.34，Wilcoxon p=0.0039

statement_original: The endothelial–matrix null survives control for sequencing depth, ribosomal and mitochondrial content, and donor.
value: 偏 r：髓系–基质 0.137, 内皮–基质 -0.021
rule: 髓系–基质 > 内皮–基质

statement_original: Myeloid–matrix is the tightest of the three pairwise couplings.
value: 偏 r：髓系–基质 0.137, 内皮–髓系 0.169
rule: 髓系–基质 为三者最大

statement_original: Within human SMC, the matrix program rises with fibromyocyte markers, so the program tracks a state rather than a lineage.
The human SMC dedifferentiation gradient is driven by loss of contractile identity (MYH11 shutdown).
The individual-level 3v3 permutation p = 0.143 reflects weak biology in the endothelial and SMC endpoints.
